item.title: SEAMEC mobilises diving support vessel for subsea pipeline inspection in KG basin
item.description: Indian offshore diving contractor SEAMEC has deployed its multi-purpose offshore support vessel for subsea pipeline and umbilical tie-back operations in Krishna Godavari deepwater offshore fields.

item.title: Deep Industries secures high-pressure subsea gas compression contract
item.description: Deep Industries has won an engineering service order for gas dehydration and subsea booster compression systems supporting deepwater offshore installations.

item.title: North Sea wind farm commissioning reaches grid connection milestone
item.description: An offshore wind farm in the European North Sea has connected its high voltage direct current converter stations.
